title: 时间胶囊：将生成幻觉作为历史意义构建的方法
summary: TimeCapsule是一个1.2B参数的LLaMA风格因果模型，仅在维多利亚时代文本上训练，实现历史隔离。相比GPT-2，困惑度降低45.4%。模型能生成历史合理的类比解释现代概念，但人文专家误判约40%真实文本为机器生成。
summary_en: TimeCapsule is a 1.2B-parameter LLaMA-style causal model trained exclusively on Victorian texts, achieving 45.4% perplexity reduction over GPT-2. It generates historically plausible analogies for modern concepts, yet humanities scholars misclassified ~40% of genuine Victorian excerpts as machine-generated.
